name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.28.2: HOTFIX - restores isoOrNull, which v6.28.1 deleted and which broke every command. Replacing the payment-port guard block in v6.28.1 removed one line that happened to sit inside the replaced region: const isoOrNull, still called in six places across handleEnqueueCommand, handleGetCommands and handleCommandHistory. Every command enqueue therefore threw a ReferenceError, which the dispatcher turns into a 500 - so opening a fridge door failed with an internal server error, and the kiosks' own command polling was failing too. node --check passes a file with a missing identifier, which is exactly the gap the project notes warn about: it catches syntax, not scope. No behaviour change beyond the restore. Cumulative over v6.28.1.
